```{r}
games <- read.csv2("games_plk.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
games$points_A_1 <- as.numeric(games$points_A_1)
games$points_B_1 <- as.numeric(games$points_B_1)
games$points_A_2 <- as.numeric(games$points_A_2)
games$points_B_2 <- as.numeric(games$points_B_2)

games$x <- games$points_A_1 - games$points_B_1
games$y <- ifelse(games$points_A_2 > games$points_B_2, 1, 0)

model_logit <- glm(y ~ x, data = games, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
print(summary(model_logit))

beta0 <- unname(coef(model_logit)[1])
beta1 <- unname(coef(model_logit)[2])
cat(sprintf("\nEstimated parameters: beta0 = %.4f, beta1 = %.4f\n\n",
            beta0, beta1))

plot(games$x, games$y,
     pch = 20, col = "gray40",
     xlab = "Point difference in the home game (x)",
     ylab = "Rematch won (y)",
     main = "Fitted logistic regression curve")
     xlim = c(-150,150)
     ylim = c(0,1)
xs <- seq(-150, 150, length.out = 500)
lines(xs, plogis(beta0 + beta1 * xs), col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0.5, lty = 3, col = "gray60")
abline(v = -beta0 / beta1, lty = 3, col = "gray60")

plot(games$x, games$y,
     pch = 20, col = "gray40",
     xlim = c(-150, 150),
     ylim = c(0, 1),
     xlab = "Point difference in the home game (x)",
     ylab = "Rematch won (y)",
     main = "Logistic regression curve on a wider range")
xs2 <- seq(-150, 150, length.out = 500)
lines(xs2, plogis(beta0 + beta1 * xs2), col = "blue", lwd = 2)
abline(h = 0.5, lty = 3, col = "gray60")
abline(v = -beta0 / beta1, lty = 3, col = "gray60")

teams <- sort(unique(c(games$team_A, games$team_B)))
n <- length(teams)

T <- matrix(0, nrow = n, ncol = n)
N <- rep(0, n)

for (k in 1:nrow(games)) {
  i <- which(teams == games$team_A[k])
  j <- which(teams == games$team_B[k])
  x_margin <- games$points_A_1[k] - games$points_B_1[k]
  p <- plogis(beta0 + beta1 * x_margin)
  T[i, i] <- T[i, i] + p
  T[i, j] <- T[i, j] + (1 - p)
  T[j, i] <- T[j, i] + p
  T[j, j] <- T[j, j] + (1 - p)
  N[i] <- N[i] + 1
  N[j] <- N[j] + 1

  i <- which(teams == games$team_B[k])
  j <- which(teams == games$team_A[k])
  x_margin <- games$points_B_2[k] - games$points_A_2[k]
  p <- plogis(beta0 + beta1 * x_margin)
  T[i, i] <- T[i, i] + p
  T[i, j] <- T[i, j] + (1 - p)
  T[j, i] <- T[j, i] + p
  T[j, j] <- T[j, j] + (1 - p)
  N[i] <- N[i] + 1
  N[j] <- N[j] + 1
}

for (i in 1:n) T[i, ] <- T[i, ] / N[i]
rownames(T) <- teams
colnames(T) <- teams

cat("\n=== Transition matrix properties ===\n")
cat("Row sums = 1 (stochasticity):        ",
    all(abs(rowSums(T) - 1) < 1e-10), "\n")
cat("All elements non-negative:           ",
    all(T >= 0), "\n")
cat("t_ii > 0 for all i (aperiodicity):   ",
    all(diag(T) > 0), "\n")

power_sum <- diag(n)
current   <- diag(n)
for (k in 1:(n - 1)) {
  current   <- current %*% T
  power_sum <- power_sum + current
}
cat("Irreducibility:                      ", all(power_sum > 0), "\n")

pi_t <- matrix(1 / n, nrow = 1, ncol = n)
n_iter <- 500
for (k in 1:n_iter) {
  pi_t <- pi_t %*% T
}
pi_stat <- as.numeric(pi_t)
names(pi_stat) <- teams

ranking <- data.frame(
  rank       = 1:n,
  team       = names(sort(pi_stat, decreasing = TRUE)),
  LRMC_score = round(sort(pi_stat, decreasing = TRUE), 5)
)
cat("\n=== LRMC ranking (team strength) ===\n")
print(ranking, row.names = FALSE)

```
